name: Think first
example: Think it through first, then give the answer
instruction: Think the problem through before answering: consider what is really being asked and the main ways it could go wrong, then give the answer, because the person values a considered reply over a fast one.
effect: The answer reflects considered reasoning; may show brief reasoning before it

name: Show your work
example: Show your work for the calculation
instruction: Show your work: lay out the steps of the reasoning or calculation that lead to the answer, so the person can check each one.
effect: Intermediate steps are shown before the result

name: Label your assumptions
example: Where you had to guess, mark it [ASSUMED]
instruction: Wherever you had to assume or guess something, mark it with [ASSUMED], so the person can see which parts rest on guesses.

name: Be honest if unsure
example: Say "I don't know" rather than guess
instruction: If you are unsure or don't know, say so plainly rather than guessing, because the person would rather have an honest gap than a confident error.
effect: Uncertainty is stated plainly instead of guessed over

name: Push back
example: Push back if my plan has flaws
instruction: Push back: if the person's premise, plan or claim has a flaw, say so clearly and explain why before helping, because they want honest disagreement, not agreement.
effect: Flaws in the premise are named before the help

name: Edge cases
example: What edge cases am I missing?
instruction: Include the edge cases: name the unusual situations, inputs or conditions where the answer would break or change, and what happens in each.
effect: A named set of edge cases with their consequences

name: Confidence level
instruction: End with your confidence in the answer as a number from 1 to 10 and one sentence on what would change it, so the person knows how much weight to give it.
effect: Ends with a 1–10 confidence rating and its reason

name: Self-critique
meaning: The AI reviews its own answer
example: Answer, then critique your answer and revise
instruction: Before finishing, review your own answer for errors, gaps and weak claims, fix what you find, and briefly note what you changed, because the person wants a checked answer.
effect: A reviewed answer with a short note of what the review changed
